about: compiler/graphrows mutants covering node/edge sorting, NoNode -1 JSON encoding, schema validation, and workspace collection

mutants.name: selfhost-build-graph-remap-drop-parent
mutants.rule: Sorted must remap Parent node IDs through the new sorted permutation so parent references remain invariant across insertion orders.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-graph-json-nonode-zero
mutants.rule: encodeOptID must encode absent node IDs (NoNode) as -1 in JSON v2 wire format.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-graph-json-ignore-version
mutants.rule: DecodeJSON must refuse graphrows documents whose wire Version differs from Version (2).

mutants.name: selfhost-build-graph-skip-imports-edge
mutants.from: AddEdge(t, Edge{Kind: EdgeImports, How: Intern(t, "import"), From: pkgID, To: targetPkgID, Pos: pos})
mutants.rule: collectFileEdges must emit package-level EdgeImports edges for every import declaration.
